title: EIGRP Neighbor Stuck in EXSTART After MTU Change
symptoms: The two routers were EIGRP neighbors yesterday
Today they show as neighbors but no routes are being exchanged
Interface MTU was changed on one router during a WAN optimization project
The physical link is up with no errors
rootCause: The EIGRP neighbor relationship is stuck in EXSTART state because the MTU values on the two interfaces do not match. EIGRP requires matching MTU for the DBD exchange to succeed. The WAN change reduced MTU on one side only.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the EIGRP neighbor state and confirms the stuck state?
steps.hint: Look at the State column - 'EXSTART' indicates the DBD exchange is failing.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the MTU configured on the interface?
steps.hint: Compare the MTU on both routers - they must match for EIGRP to work.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the EIGRP topology table to confirm no routes are being learned?
steps.hint: If the topology table is empty, the neighbor relationship never completed.
